item.title: Chicago's mayor carved six Xs into a runway; 12 years later, the airfield became a 40-acre park
item.description: Chicago's Meigs Field airport was controversially closed overnight in 2003. Six X-shaped gouges rendered the runway unusable, stranding sixteen aircraft. The city cited security concerns following the September 11 attacks for the closure. Twelve years later, the former airfield became a natural landscape. This site now features prairie, wetlands, and wildlife habitat for migratory birds. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
